message: Fixes: durations like 1 hour 59 minutes now read "2h" instead of "2.0h". A supply that has already run out is now the first to get a reorder reminder. Choosing the same day again for a repeating task you moved earlier (for example to set a time of day) no longer resets its schedule. When today is full, tasks pulled in from quiet projects are now spread across different days instead of all landing on the same one. When syncing merges two copies of the same grocery item or recipe, a price now keeps its own quantity and a cook keeps its own timings.
